finalText:
account_id shows up in 94 files. 75 of those are safe to rename together: plain internal code in the accounts, orders, billing, notify and analytics services.

Four places must keep the old name:
- `vendor/reporting-sdk` — a copied-in package. Gets overwritten wholesale on every vendor refresh.
- All 12 files in `migrations/` — already run in production. Editing them won't rename a live column, it just breaks their rollback step.
- `lib/serialize.js` — maps internal fields to the public API. Its comment says this name is frozen by contract.
- `docs/openapi.yaml` — the public API itself names the field `account_id`, in two object schemas and a query parameter.

One more worth a quick check: `lib/audit.js` writes `account_id` into every audit log line. Ask the team if old logs get searched by that field name before touching it.

To actually change the database column, that needs a brand new migration, not an edit to an old one.
